Name: Lumisteria FCF Artifact Field
Author: Lumisteria
Description:
This is a content pack for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10506]Farm Cave Framework[/url] adding an option for Demetrius to set an archeological field when worms bring various things to the surface.


Various roots and minerals may be the most common outcome, but most of the artifacts you can find in the mine, and some others, may also be found here. If you don't like mining, or find artifacts too rare, this is an option to get some of them !

This mods requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10506]Farm Cave Framework[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].

Thanks for Aedenthorn for all the work creating frameworks !

Note : if you already have set the choice for the cave and would like to change it, the framework config option allows you to do so. Just go into the framework folder (not the one of this mod) and set the config "ResetEvent" to true.
